type.description: Line type: 'old' = deleted/original line, 'new' = added/modified line, null = unchanged context. MUST match the line_code format and old_line/new_line values.

state.description: Return opened, upcoming, current, closed, or all iterations.

search.description: Return only iterations with a title matching the provided string.

search_in.description: Fields in which fuzzy search should be performed with the query given in the argument search. The available options are title and cadence_title. Default is [title].

include_descendants.description: Include iterations for group and its descendants. Defaults to false.

after.description: If defined, Returns events created after the specified date (YYYY-MM-DD format). To include events on 2025-08-29, use after=2025-08-28

order_by.description: The field to use as order. Either released_at (default) or created_at.

sort.description: The direction of the order. Either desc (default) for descending order or asc for ascending order.

tools.name: get_release
tools.description: Get a release by tag name

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path

tag_name.description: The Git tag the release is associated with

include_html_description.description: If true, a response includes HTML rendered Markdown of the release description.

tools.name: create_release
tools.description: Create a new release in a GitLab project

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path

tag_name.description: The tag where the release is created from

tag_message.description: Message to use if creating a new annotated tag

description.description: The description of the release. You can use Markdown.

ref.description: If a tag specified in tag_name doesn't exist, the release is created from ref and tagged with tag_name. It can be a commit SHA, another tag name, or a branch name.

milestones.description: The title of each milestone the release is associated with. GitLab Premium customers can specify group milestones.

name.description: The name of the link. Link names must be unique within the release.

url.description: The URL of the link. Link URLs must be unique within the release.

direct_asset_path.description: Optional path for a direct asset link.

link_type.description: The type of the link: other, runbook, image, package. Defaults to other.

released_at.description: Date and time for the release. Defaults to the current time. Expected in ISO 8601 format (2019-03-15T08:00:00Z). Only provide this field if creating an upcoming or historical release.

tools.name: update_release
tools.description: Update an existing release in a GitLab project

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path

tag_name.description: The Git tag the release is associated with

description.description: The description of the release. You can use Markdown.

milestones.description: The title of each milestone to associate with the release. GitLab Premium customers can specify group milestones. To remove all milestones from the release, specify [].

released_at.description: The date when the release is/was ready. Expected in ISO 8601 format (2019-03-15T08:00:00Z).

tools.name: delete_release
tools.description: Delete a release from a GitLab project (does not delete the associated tag)

tag_name.description: The Git tag the release is associated with
